verdict.rationale: Stable's own marketing describes background automations that users configure: keyword-based auto-routing of mail to teams, an AI-powered inbox that automatically sorts and routes mail, automated check deposits, and configurable alerts. These run without manual intervention. However, the evidence is marketing-level only, and the automations are confined to fixed mail-handling actions rather than a general, user-definable automation system. missing for 10: documentation on how automation rules are configured (triggers, conditions, actions), any general-purpose or agent-driven workflow builder, scheduling or background-job controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the automations run reliably.
